SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT County, cnt
    FROM closed_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.County, s.School, s.ClosedDate
FROM schools s
JOIN max_count mc ON s.County = mc.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s.School

SELECT s.School, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-9'

SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName2 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName2 != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, AdmFName3 AS first_name FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName3 != ''
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT first_name, cnt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rnk
    FROM name_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.first_name, s.District
FROM admin_names a
JOIN ranked r ON a.first_name = r.first_name
JOIN schools s ON a.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE r.rnk <= 2
ORDER BY a.first_name, s.District

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE duration > 12
),
account_max_amount AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, MAX(l.amount) AS max_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN accounts_with_long_loan a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
filtered_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, m.max_amount
    FROM account a
    JOIN account_max_amount m ON a.account_id = m.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
)
SELECT account_id
FROM filtered_accounts
WHERE max_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_amount) FROM filtered_accounts)

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03'

SELECT AVG(amount)
FROM loan
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT disp.account_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    WHERE client.gender = 'M'
)

SELECT A3, A2
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district)

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541

SELECT client.client_id
FROM `order`
JOIN account ON `order`.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE `order`.order_id = 32423

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT')

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY client.client_id
ORDER BY MAX(loan.amount) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN `order` ON disp.account_id = `order`.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
  AND client.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
  AND client.birth_date <= '1976-12-31'
  AND `order`.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND `order`.amount > 4000
